eyebrow: A real Argo Rollouts canary strategy
code:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
spec:
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
        - setWeight: 10
        - pause: { duration: 5m }
        - setWeight: 25
        - pause: { duration: 5m }
        - setWeight: 50
        - pause: { duration: 10m }
        - setWeight: 100
caption: setWeight routes that percentage of traffic; pause holds it before the controller advances.

code:
# canary
#   + small blast radius, caught early
#   - needs real traffic-splitting infra (mesh/ingress)
#
# blue-green
#   + instant, unambiguous rollback; full environment parity
#   - all-or-nothing cutover; 2x infra during the overlap
caption: Most teams mix both — blue-green for low-risk internal services, canary for customer-facing traffic.
